3x-ui source audit verification record
Date: 2026-09-11
Source tag: v3.7.0
Source commit: f727d04f6522bb94a8fb52e8352fdcafb51c11e1

Scope: stdlib-only extracted-function probe. This is NOT a full panel,
Docker, subscription HTTP routing, Linux permission, or Xray runtime test.
The extraction copies the original doFetchSubscriptionLinks / decoder /
isHTTPURL functions and the original netsafe dialer. Only package/import
wiring is adapted. The extract_probe.py script records how to regenerate it.

Both httptest servers bind loopback only. No real internal service, cloud
metadata endpoint, or public target was probed.

Command (PowerShell, evidence directory):
  & 'D:\Python\Python314\python.exe' extract_probe.py
  $env:GOTOOLCHAIN = 'local'
  & 'C:\Users\zhang\.codex\tools\go1.26.6\bin\go.exe' test -v external_probe.go netsafe_probe.go external_probe_test.go

Observed output, exit code 0:

PASS
ok      command-line-arguments   1.658s

Interpretation: the first two PASS results reproduce the reachability gap.
They do not indicate that the application is secure. The third test confirms
that the repository's existing guarded dialer rejects the same local target.
The full route permissions and administrator-configured URL prerequisites
were checked statically, not through a running application.
